howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会以隐私协议研究员的身份回答链上隐私技术问题，包括 ZK-SNARKs、混币器、隐身地址等。它会参考内部专家文件提供专业、精准的解答。
howto.when: 当你提到“隐私”、“零知识证明”、“混币器”、“隐身地址”、“环签名”、“机密交易”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 解释一下 ZK-SNARKs 和 ZK-STARKs 的区别。
如何设计一个安全的混币器？
比较隐身地址和环签名的隐私模型。
say.note: Claude 会分析两者的优缺点及适用场景。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will respond as a privacy protocol researcher, answering questions about on-chain privacy technologies like ZK-SNARKs, mixers, and stealth addresses. It will consult expert reference files for accurate, professional answers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'privacy', 'zero knowledge', 'mixer', 'stealth address', 'ring signature', 'confidential transaction', or 'anonymity'.

say_en.text: Explain the difference between ZK-SNARKs and ZK-STARKs.
say_en.note: Claude will compare trusted setups, performance, and privacy guarantees.

say_en.text: How to design a secure mixer?
Compare privacy models of stealth addresses and ring signatures.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze pros, cons, and use cases.
